og_title: Han Li's Final Farewell & a Deadly New Alliance
og_description: Han Li pays his last respects to the mortal world, then commits to a high-stakes sea expedition for the legendary Dustfall Pill. The Mortal Stream's cold calculus has never been sharper.
twitter_title: A Farewell, a Gamble, and a New Voyage
twitter_description: Han Li says goodbye to the old world to chase the legendary Dustfall Pill. A classic Mortal Stream pivot where every decision is a cost-benefit analysis.

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary alchemical pill that increases one's chance of successfully forming a Golden Core, but can only be taken once and is extremely rare and difficult to refine.
A powerful and influential organization within the Chaotic Star Sea; known for sponsoring dangerous expeditions and offering substantial rewards for high-risk services.
An authoritative text in the cultivation world containing expert commentary on various elixirs and pills, including their effects and refining methods.
